semiconductor_relevance: High — Duksan Hi-Metal specializes in solder ball manufacturing, which is critical for semiconductor packaging processes.
summary: Duksan Hi-Metal is a manufacturer of solder balls and related materials used in semiconductor packaging. The company focuses on developing advanced soldering materials that enhance performance and efficiency in semiconductor assembly processes.
capabilities: Micro solder balls for advanced miniaturization
Solder paste for surface mount technology (SMT)
Cu core balls for enhanced thermal performance
